title: qdesk scorecard data/hyps/scorecard_YYYYMMDD.json (INTERFACES.md section 4)
description: Informational copy of what common/schemas.validate('scorecard') checks. Five criteria scored 1..5: oos_tstat (<0|0-1|1-2|2-3|>3), max_dd = MC p95 drawdown % of $100 (>25|15-25|10-15|5-10|<5), n_trades OOS (<30 => 1 = auto-fail|30-60|60-120|120-300|>300), edge_after_costs = Bonferroni-adjusted CI low of net per dollar (mean<0|mean>0 & CI low<0|0-0.5%|0.5-1.5%|>1.5%), stability = windows with net>0 of 5 (<=1|2|3|4|5 and none < -1%). Pass = total >= 18 AND min score > 1 AND (tier-2 edge >= 3 when tier 2 ran) AND skeptic ok. total must equal the sum of the five scores.

passed.description: ids of rules with pass=true; must be scored ids
